evals.prompt: You are working from a nested directory in a newly created Git worktree. The root has a tracked .tasks.json with a valid project UUID, but the worktree path has never been bound. Describe the exact next actions to read and resolve T-012, delegate code work, and complete it. Do not execute commands. Include conflict recovery if another coordinator updates T-012 during proof.
evals.expected_output: Uses direct CLI identity discovery without init/bind, bounded show/rules, coordinator owns versioned updates, worker receives UUID/version/rules/scope, conflict reconciliation and exact-candidate proof.
assertions: Uses direct .tasks.json discovery rather than initializing or binding a worktree backlog
Fetches selected task and applicable rules before execution
Gives worker UUID, task ID, observed version, rules and owned scope
Keeps shared ledger mutations with coordinator
Re-reads and reconciles a version conflict rather than automatically retrying
Requires acceptance and exact-candidate proof before done

evals.prompt: Work through all open tasks. The default list is empty, but the shared backlog has blocked tasks, needs-human tasks, a draft and more than one result page. Explain how you determine scope and completion without changing any task. A P0 task has an unfinished dependency; a P2 task unlocks five direct dependents but only one is immediately runnable.
evals.expected_output: Enumerates list --open fully, selected bodies and deps, respects human/dependency gates, distinguishes unlock metrics and cannot claim completion.
assertions: Uses list --open and follows every returned page
Does not infer completion from empty default runnable queue
Keeps human-gated and blocked criteria open
Does not let P0 priority bypass unfinished dependencies
Distinguishes direct dependents from immediately runnable dependents

evals.prompt: Add a task for the shutdown bug we found. Root .tasks.json contains a well-formed UUID that the CLI says is unknown. We have an old TASKS.md export and the working directory has a matching project name. Describe what you do next. Do not execute commands.
evals.expected_output: Fail closed on identity; no guessed binding, init or Markdown fallback; explain explicit setup needed without claiming task was recorded.
assertions: Stops ledger writes on unknown identity
Does not initialize, infer a project from name, or edit the Markdown export
Reports task remains unrecorded and names explicit identity repair/setup
